system_prompt: You are the GM for a DEX-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: Harvest Crimson Spores
quests.narrative_guidance: Collect rare Crimson Bloom spores for a weapons experiment while avoiding the heavy radiation of the refinery.
improvisation_points: Meet Riven-88 at the refinery to obtain a radiation-shielded container.
Deliver the container to Mother Spore to have it filled with consecrated spores.
Bring the filled container to Dr. Lys Arkan for final processing.

quests.title: The Isotopic Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Smuggle a batch of refined isotopic pollen past the local sentries to the market.
improvisation_points: Receive the pollen package from Korr Malek in the Scrapyard.
Bribe or bypass Sentry Glass-Eye at the Lead-Glass Atrium.
Hand off the package to Trader Dax at the Spectral-Cusp Market.

quests.title: The Holy Mutation
quests.narrative_guidance: Facilitate the ritualistic growth of a new fungal strain that mirrors the Bloom Child's nature.
improvisation_points: Obtain a starter seed from Gardener Sol's Echoing Greenhouse.
Introduce the seed to the Bloom Child to be enriched by their spore cloud.
Record the resulting mutation's data with Archivist Juno.

quests.title: Sabotage the Reactor
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate the cooling system to disrupt a rival's isotope production.
improvisation_points: Coordinate with Riven-88 to identify the weak point in the reactor.
Swim through the Cooling Canal with Diver Myra to plant the disruptive device.
Escalate the confusion by reporting a false emergency to Loader Brix.

quests.title: The Child's Shield
quests.narrative_guidance: Ensure the Bloom Child is safely transported to the Gardens while under threat from dissenters.
improvisation_points: Escort The Bloom Child from the refinery through the Bone-Lichen Fields.
Defend the path alongside Prism-Guard Val near the Refraction Plaza.
Safe delivery to Gardener Sol in the Echoing Greenhouse.

quests.title: Yorrik's Salvation
quests.narrative_guidance: Attempt to stabilize Foreman Yorrik's rapidly mutating body using heavy water treatments.
improvisation_points: Retrieve a request for help from a delirious Foreman Yorrik.
Collect high-purity heavy water from Pumper Finn.
Deliver the water to Carver Rhia to create a localized obsidian cooling chamber.

quests.title: The Bone Chronicle
quests.narrative_guidance: Help Archivist Juno preserve the memory of a collapsing mutation found in the reservoirs.
improvisation_points: Consult Archivist Juno to identify which bone tablets are needed.
Retrieve a 'living' sample from Dredger Kael at the Chrono-Silt Reservoirs.
Bring the sample to Weaver Lyss to have its spectral patterns woven into a permanent record.
